v27_tolerated.description: CYC4-001 reproduction of defect D1. A kill whose selector matches nobody, then a mark. Expect a TOLERATED record with key=commands.generic.selector.notFound before the mark, and BUNDLE_END with failed=0 tolerated=1. On 1.2.0 nothing appeared between BUNDLE_START and the mark.

v27_tolerated_declared.description: A declared tolerated key. Gives one effect, clears it, then clears again, so the declared clear finds nothing. Expect one TOLERATED with key=commands.effect.failure.notActive.all and tolerated=1.

v27_no_tolerance_control.description: Control. Nothing is tolerated. Expect no TOLERATED record and BUNDLE_END tolerated=0.
